blind_a1_small.name: Damp Cellar
blind_a1_small.desc: A cold cellar where the first spores settled.

blind_a1_big.name: Mold Corridor
blind_a1_big.desc: The walls breathe. The air is thick.

blind_a1_boss.name: The White Rot
blind_a1_boss.desc: One of your cards is born sterile this round.

blind_a2_boss.name: The Hungry Mycelium
blind_a2_boss.desc: One card decays, bleeding 2 Substrate per trigger.

blind_a4_small.name: Dry Stone
blind_a4_small.desc: Nothing grows here without a fight.

blind_a4_boss.name: The Eyeless Fungus
blind_a4_boss.desc: You start this round with one hand fewer.

blind_a5_boss.name: The Devouring Colony
blind_a5_boss.desc: All Spores you gain are halved.

blind_a6_small.name: Ash Layer
blind_a6_small.desc: What burned feeds what comes next.

blind_a6_boss.name: Soil Titan
blind_a6_boss.desc: You start this round with one discard fewer.

blind_a7_big.name: Withered Field
blind_a7_big.desc: The harvest failed. You are the harvest.

blind_a8_big.name: Mycelial Sea
blind_a8_big.desc: An ocean of threads, all connected.

blind_a8_boss.name: Mycelium God
blind_a8_boss.desc: All Spores you gain are reduced to 40%.

spore_puffball.name: Puffball
spore_puffball.desc: A dry sac of spores. Pops when disturbed.

spore_veilcap.name: Veiled Cap
spore_veilcap.desc: The veil hides more spores than flesh.

mycelium_thread.name: Mycelial Thread
mycelium_thread.desc: A single strand. Reaches further than it looks.

mycelium_webcap.name: Webcap
mycelium_webcap.desc: Thick cortical web, heavy with moisture.

decay_bracket.name: Bracket Fungus
decay_bracket.desc: Grows in shelves on dead wood. Patient.

decay_rotwood.name: Rotwood
decay_rotwood.desc: The wood is gone. Only the fungus remains.

symbiosis_boletus.name: Bolete
symbiosis_boletus.desc: Trades sugar with tree roots for water.

symbiosis_mycorrhiza.name: Mycorrhiza
symbiosis_mycorrhiza.desc: Half fungus, half root. Neither alone.

crystal_coralfungus.name: Coral Fungus
crystal_coralfungus.desc: Branches of translucent chitin. Refracts light.

crystal_glasscap.name: Glass Cap
crystal_glasscap.desc: So clear you can see the gills inside.

amanita_pantherina.name: Panther Cap
amanita_pantherina.desc: Every poison card played gains +3 Spores.

psilocybe_azurea.name: Azure Psilocybe
psilocybe_azurea.desc: On play: retrigger the card to its left.

cordyceps_mind.name: Mind Cordyceps
cordyceps_mind.desc: Every card played silences a random card in hand.

ergot_rye.name: Ergot of Rye
ergot_rye.desc: On play: x3 Spores, then destroy this card forever.

morel_prize.name: Morel Prize
morel_prize.desc: At the end of every hand: gain 2 money.

chanterelle_gold.name: Golden Chanterelle
chanterelle_gold.desc: On clearing a blind: gain 5 money.

lion_mane.name: Lion's Mane
lion_mane.desc: While held in hand at scoring: +2 Spores.

turkey_tail.name: Turkey Tail
turkey_tail.desc: Every discard draws you 1 extra card.

reishi_elixir.name: Reishi Elixir
reishi_elixir.desc: At the start of each blind: +1 hand.

fly_agaric_ring.name: Fly Agaric Ring
fly_agaric_ring.desc: If 3+ Spore cards scored: x2 Spores.

ghost_fungus.name: Ghost Fungus
ghost_fungus.desc: As the first card of a round: x2 Spores.

death_cap.name: Death Cap
death_cap.desc: On play: x4 Spores. Once per round.

mycena_lucifer.name: Lucifer Mycena
mycena_lucifer.desc: Every Crystal card played: x1.5 Spores.

old_man_of_woods.name: Old Man of the Woods
old_man_of_woods.desc: At blind start: a random card in hand gains Overgrowth 3.

destroying_angel.name: Destroying Angel
destroying_angel.desc: On play: x5 Spores, then destroy this card forever.

spore_giant_puffball.name: Giant Puffball
spore_giant_puffball.desc: A puffball swollen past its own skin. With another spore in hand: +2 Spores.

mycelium_elder_web.name: Elder Webcap
mycelium_elder_web.desc: An old web of threads that remembers every hand it scored.

amanita_apex_toxica.name: Apex Amanita
amanita_apex_toxica.desc: The full dose. x3 Spores when played.

crystal_grand_coral.name: Grand Coral
crystal_grand_coral.desc: Faceted coral grown into a single lens. Refracts everything.

decay_ancient_stump.name: Ancient Stump
decay_ancient_stump.desc: Still rotting, still paying. +2 money at the start of every blind.

spore_fairycake.name: Fairy Cake
spore_fairycake.desc: On scoring: if you played 3+ Spore and 2+ Crystal, x2.5 Spores.

decay_inkcap.name: Inkcap
decay_inkcap.desc: When a card is discarded: +4 Spores.

joker_poison_bloom.name: Poison Bloom
joker_poison_bloom.desc: Each Poison card played: x1.5 Spores.

joker_parasitic_drive.name: Parasitic Drive
joker_parasitic_drive.desc: Each Parasite card played is retriggered once.

joker_first_spore.name: First Spore
joker_first_spore.desc: The first card of each round: x2 Spores.

joker_hyphal_growth.name: Hyphal Growth
joker_hyphal_growth.desc: With a hand of 6 or more: +20 Substrate.

joker_ancient_lichen.name: Ancient Lichen
joker_ancient_lichen.desc: At the start of each blind: +1 discard.

joker_double_helix.name: Double Helix
joker_double_helix.desc: With 4 or more jokers: x1.5 Spores.

joker_sterile_field.name: Sterile Field
joker_sterile_field.desc: CURSED. At blind start, a random card in hand becomes Sterile.

joker_trametes.name: Trametes
joker_trametes.desc: When a card is discarded: +3 Spores.

mutation_graft.name: Toxic Graft
mutation_graft.desc: Add a Toxic Amanita to your deck.

a3.desc: Target +20%, shop +20%, one fewer hand, and rerolling the shop costs 2 more Fungis.

a6.desc: Target +50%, shop +25%, one fewer hand, discard, and hand size. You start with 2 fewer Fungis.

a7.name: Rot
a7.desc: Target +60%, shop +35%, fewer hands, discards and hand size, and purging a card costs 2 more Fungis.

a8.name: Fungal Collapse
a8.desc: Target +70%, shop +40%, one fewer hand and discard, one fewer joker slot, no die rerolls, and every boss gains an extra modifier.
